scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c green,blue "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.setup: npm run db:local && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.test: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w apps/api && node --test tests/api.test.mjs
